name: QuaRot KV cache 4-bit (rotated KV, no retained outlier channels)
bits: 4-bit KV cache (keys and values), obtained after Hadamard rotation; part of the w4a4kv4 configuration
activation_scheme: Not an activation scheme - the KV cache is rotated with the same orthogonal transforms as the rest of the network, using computational invariance, so the cache can be 4-bit with NO channels retained at higher precision.
notes: Separate KV record for the rotation family's KV claim, for the same reason as llm-qat-kv-cache: 'does this method quantize the KV cache, and at what bit width with what outlier handling' is a question the schema forces into notes and the answer differs per method (KIVI: 2/4 asymmetric per-channel/per-token; QuaRot: 4/4 rotated, no outliers retained; LLM-QAT: 4/4 trained; QServe: 4-bit with SmoothAttention). Making that a first-class field rather than a note would be a schema change worth considering. SpinQuant inherits this same 4-bit KV result; between QuaRot and SpinQuant the KV story is effectively one result reported twice, with SpinQuant's rotations learned rather than fixed. SCHEME RECLASSIFIED (parent agent, 2026-10-03): scheme was 'spinquant' (a proxy recorded while the enum lacked a legal value) and is now 'kv-cache-quant'.
